test_validation.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_scope_guardrails.py tests/test_scope_resolver.py tests/test_authorization_gate_sync_scope.py tests/test_bug_bounty_dispatch_safety.py tests/test_bug_bounty_continuous.py tests/test_api_security_and_routing.py

findings.title: Default scope policy allows arbitrary targets when allowlist is empty
findings.current_behavior: strict_allowlist=false with empty allowlist yields policy_default_allow
findings.risk_if_unchanged: Out-of-scope scanning can be authorized by default on fresh setup
findings.recommended_change: Set strict_allowlist=true by default or ship restrictive allowlist bootstrap
findings.resolution_notes: Set default strict_allowlist=true in repository scope guardrails config to enforce deny-by-default posture.

findings.title: Conftest import order can break pytest collection outside repo cwd
findings.current_behavior: tests.asgi_test_client import runs before sys.path bootstrap
findings.risk_if_unchanged: Test collection fails in common invocation contexts, blocking CI/dev reliability
findings.recommended_change: Reorder path bootstrap before tests import or avoid absolute tests package import
findings.resolution_notes: Moved repository path bootstrap before tests package import in conftest; verified pytest collection from non-repo cwd.

findings.title: Synchronous scope validation ignores workflow-aware context
findings.current_behavior: workflow_id is discarded in scope_validator() and static policy is always used
findings.risk_if_unchanged: Scope decisions diverge between sync and async paths for workflow-scoped executions
findings.recommended_change: Restore workflow-aware resolution in sync path, consistent with async behavior
findings.resolution_notes: Restored workflow-aware sync scope validation by delegating to canonical scope_resolver when workflow_id is supplied.

findings.title: Dispatch-due path can enqueue duplicate schedule runs
findings.current_behavior: No reservation/idempotency marker prevents repeated dispatch of same due schedule
findings.risk_if_unchanged: Duplicate worker tasks, inflated load, repeated scans, noisy state transitions
findings.recommended_change: Add atomic dispatch reservation and idempotent dispatch key semantics
findings.resolution_notes: Added schedule reservation behavior before enqueue (next_scheduled_run_at advance) so repeated dispatch-due calls do not immediately duplicate dispatch.

findings.title: Dispatch-due lacks explicit broker failure handling
findings.current_behavior: Celery enqueue exceptions are not converted into structured dispatch failure records
findings.risk_if_unchanged: Partial dispatch with opaque 500s and weak operator diagnostics
findings.recommended_change: Handle per-schedule enqueue failures and persist dispatch diagnostics
findings.resolution_notes: Wrapped worker enqueue path with per-schedule exception handling and persisted dispatch failure status/reason in schedule and response payload.

push_recommendation.reason: Critical and high-priority release blockers have been resolved and validated with full pytest plus targeted regression coverage.
